iPerf 3.21 for Windows distribution notice
==========================================

ProtoDeck invokes iPerf as a separate process. The Windows application bundle
contains the unmodified recommended 64-bit iPerf 3.21 runtime published at:

https://github.com/ar51an/iperf3-win-builds/releases/tag/3.21

The downloaded archive is pinned by SHA-256 in
tool/build_bundled_iperf_windows.ps1. It contains iperf3.exe and the Cygwin
3.6.7 runtime (cygwin1.dll).

iPerf is distributed under its BSD-style license. A copy is included as
iperf3-LICENSE.txt.

The Cygwin runtime is free software covered by the GNU Lesser General Public
License version 3 or later with the Cygwin linking exception. The exact
corresponding Cygwin 3.6.7-1 source package, including its complete license
texts and build recipe, is included in:

source/cygwin-3.6.7-1-src.tar.xz

Cygwin licensing information: https://cygwin.com/licensing.html
Cygwin source mirror: https://ftp.fau.de/cygwin/src/release/cygwin/

ProtoDeck does not modify iperf3.exe or cygwin1.dll.
